themes.title: Far-right leaders rally behind convicted killer as political symbol
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Italy, Spain, and the US are using the case of Mario Roggero, a jeweler convicted of killing two robbers, to push for expanded self-defense laws and pardon campaigns. This theme highlights a coordinated effort to frame Roggero as a symbol of victimhood and resistance against perceived judicial overreach, with leaders like Matteo Salvini and Giorgia Meloni advocating for legal reforms to support his case.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox aligns with PP in Valencia to push conservative policies, indirectly supporting narratives around self-defense and victimhood.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration's rhetoric on law and order aligns with self-defense narratives, though not directly tied to Roggero.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push voting age reforms to engage youth
themes.blurb: Hungary, Italy, and Sweden are debating or implementing policies to lower the voting age to 16, aiming to engage younger voters with right-wing ideologies. This theme reflects a strategic effort to expand electoral bases by appealing to youth, often framed as a way to counter left-wing dominance in educational institutions.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders exploit crime and security concerns
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Italy, Spain, and the US are leveraging crime and security issues to push for stricter immigration policies, expanded self-defense laws, and tougher policing. This theme reflects a coordinated effort to frame security as a national priority, often linking it to broader cultural and identity politics.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni and Salvini push for stricter policing and self-defense laws, using high-profile crime cases to justify reforms.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox links crime to immigration, advocating for stricter policies and criticizing left-wing responses to security issues.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration emphasizes law and order, with policies targeting immigration and crime as central campaign themes.
